Threat.value: Taking too many risks or doing things that could cause you harm
I am unable to relax even when I know I am in a safe place
I jump or startle at ordinary sounds that would not bother most people

Memory.value: My memories of the event feel more real and vivid than memories of ordinary things
When I remember the event I feel intense rage
Something in my surroundings can instantly bring back the full memory without warning

Negative Appraisals.value: I should have protected others and I failed

vignette: Sang is an 18-year-old South Eastern Asian male who recently returned from a combat deployment. He works as a photographer and has been struggling with the aftermath of his traumatic experiences in the field. His days are filled with intense emotions that leave him feeling on edge and disconnected from those around him. During his deployment, Sang witnessed and experienced harrowing events that have left lasting imprints on his psyche. One particular incident involved an ambush where he narrowly escaped injury but saw others suffer severe wounds. This event has been the catalyst for his current psychological distress. Since returning home, Sang finds himself constantly on high alert, unable to relax even in safe environments like his apartment or studio. He takes unnecessary risks while driving and often pushes himself beyond safety limits during photo shoots, believing that he can control dangerous situations. Sang is haunted by vivid memories of the ambush. These memories feel more real and vivid than any other recollections from his life. They are triggered without warning, often by sounds or sights that remind him of the combat environment—like a loud bang or the sight of camouflaged uniforms. When these triggers activate, he experiences intense rage, which further exacerbates his sense of threat. His belief that he no longer belongs anywhere and that people cannot be trusted is deeply ingrained in Sang’s psyche. He feels an overwhelming sense of failure for not being able to protect others during the ambush. This mistrust and feeling of isolation contribute significantly to his heightened state of anxiety, making him overly cautious and quick to react defensively. For example, one day while out taking photos at a crowded street festival, a fireworks display suddenly began. The loud booms instantly brought back memories of gunfire, causing Sang to feel an immediate surge of rage and panic. He was certain that he would not be able to protect himself or others from harm, just as he felt powerless during the ambush. This incident left him feeling even more isolated and mistrustful. Sang’s negative appraisals have also intensified his experience with triggers and memories. When he recalls the traumatic event, the vividness of these memories reinforces his belief that he does not belong anywhere and cannot trust anyone. The intensity of these memories often leads to him becoming highly agitated or avoiding situations where such triggers might occur. His occupation as a photographer has been particularly challenging. He finds it difficult to focus on capturing everyday moments without feeling hypervigilant, constantly scanning for potential threats. This hyperawareness affects his work and interactions with clients. Sang avoids certain photo shoots in noisy environments, knowing that the sounds could trigger flashbacks. Over time, this avoidance has led him to miss out on many professional opportunities. What finally brought Sang to seek help was a growing realization that he was struggling more than he had initially thought. He feared that his constant state of anxiety and mistrust would isolate him further from friends and family. Despite feeling like an outsider, Sang is hopeful that therapy might provide some relief from the overwhelming sense of threat and allow him to reconnect with those around him. Sang’s current state is marked by a cycle where his negative appraisals intensify feelings of threat, leading to more vivid and intrusive memories, which in turn reinforce his mistrust and sense of failure. He is determined to break this cycle and regain control over his life.
